signature.why: The combo. Devoted Druid untaps itself for a -1/-1 counter and Vizier of Remedies or either Tyvar stops the counter from arriving, which is infinite green mana; 10/10 field lists run 4 Druid and 4 Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler and at least one of the other two.

The accelerants that make the combo a turn-three kill rather than a turn-five one, 10/10 in the field at 4 Halfling, 4 Leyline and 4 Badgermole Cub. Leyline also untaps a Druid on its own, so this clause is half mana and half redundancy for the combo above.

The tutors. Every field list runs 4 Green Sun's Zenith and 4 Nature's Rhythm: a two-card combo in a 60 is only consistent when eight or more cards find either half, and it is what lets the singleton toolbox in the list be a plan rather than a hope.
